heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny, except partly cloudy in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Increasing clouds. Lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s, except mid to upper 30s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Winds becoming light and variable, except south 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtering through variable high clouds. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s, except mid to upper 50s in southeastern valleys. West to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph.
